content.json: **NOTE**: This data connector depends on a parser based on Kusto Function **Snowflake** to work as expected. [Follow steps to get this Kusto Function](https://aka.ms/sentinel-SnowflakeDataConnector-parser)

parameters.name: TimeRange
parameters.description: Sets the time name for analysis

content.query:
Snowflake
| make-series TotalEvents = count() default = 0 on TimeGenerated from {TimeRange:start} to {TimeRange:end} step {TimeRange:grain};
content.title: Events Over Time

content.query:
Snowflake
| summarize s=sum(QueryExecutionTime)
| project s_time = strcat(s/1000, ' sec')
content.title: Total Query Time

content.query:
Snowflake
| summarize cs = sum(QueryCreditsUsedCloudServices)
| project round(cs, 8)
content.title: Credits Spent

content.query:
Snowflake
| where isnotempty(TableNames)
| summarize count() by TableNames
content.title: Table Events Summary

content.query:
Snowflake
| where isnotempty(DatabaseName)
| summarize count() by DatabaseName
content.title: Database Events Summary

content.query:
Snowflake
| where isnotempty(SrcDvcIpAddr)
| summarize count() by SrcDvcIpAddr
content.title: Source Addresses

content.query:
Snowflake
| where QueryExecutionTime > 0
| top 10 by QueryExecutionTime desc
| project Query=QueryText, User=TargetUsername, ExecutionTime=QueryExecutionTime
content.title: Query Execution Time

content.query:
Snowflake
| where QueryCreditsUsedCloudServices > 0
| summarize by QueryText, QueryCreditsUsedCloudServices
| top 10 by QueryCreditsUsedCloudServices desc
| project Query=QueryText, CreditsSpent=QueryCreditsUsedCloudServices
content.title: Credits Spent by Queries

content.query:
Snowflake
| where QueryType == 'CREATE_USER'
| extend n_usr = extract(@'USER\s(\S+)', 1, QueryText)
| project Username=n_usr
content.title: New Users

content.query:
Snowflake

| where QueryType =~ 'SELECT'
| summarize roles = makeset(RoleName) by TargetUsername
| join(Snowflake
        | where LoginEventType =~ 'LOGIN') on TargetUsername
| project EventTime=TimeGenerated, TargetUsername, SourceAddress=SrcDvcIpAddr, Status=strcat(iif(LoginIsSuccess =~ 'No', '❌ - Login Failure' , '✅ - Logged in'))
content.title: Privileged Sessions
